description: Land Acquisition - Baduraliya, Palindanuwara D/S Division, Kalutara District
categorisation: This gazette content is a notice under the Land Acquisition Act regarding the government's intention to acquire specific land parcels and servitudes for public purpose. It contains detailed descriptions of multiple land lots (including lot numbers, ownership details, and extents), specifies the exact location of the properties, and includes procedures for interested parties to claim compensation. This content fits squarely within the Land Gazette category as it deals exclusively with land acquisition matters.
